name: Hafeefa PC
role: AI/ML Automation Engineer | Generative AI & Full-Stack Systems
intro: I engineer intelligent systems that connect applied AI, rigorous evaluation and dependable software engineering.
about: I work at the intersection of Generative AI, LLM-powered agents and software engineering, translating complex technical problems into modular, testable systems. My work spans AI safety and evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, machine learning and full-stack application development.

I approach engineering through clear problem decomposition, evidence-driven experimentation and deliberate trade-offs. From grounding LLM responses in domain-specific knowledge to evaluating fraud detection models on imbalanced data, I focus on building systems whose behavior can be tested, understood and improved.

Beyond implementation, I enjoy exploring emerging technologies, competing in engineering hackathons and turning technical ideas into working products. I am particularly interested in reliable AI agents, scalable data systems and the engineering practices that make intelligent applications useful in the real world.
